scripts.build: tsc -b packages/kernel packages/channel packages/tap packages/automation packages/cli packages/server && npm run build:web && npm run build:server && npm run bundle
scripts.build:server: esbuild packages/server/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=packages/server/dist/dashboard.mjs && chmod +x packages/server/dist/dashboard.mjs
scripts.bundle: esbuild packages/cli/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=packages/cli/dist/pipeline.mjs && chmod +x packages/cli/dist/pipeline.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:web
scripts.oracle: bash tools/oracle/run.sh backend-full default-effects default-guard-errors frontend-quotegate pm-history
